items.prompt: Synovial fluid leukocytes from 24 gout patients were RNA-sequenced at flare and at remission; we also hold promoter scans of transcription factor binding sites and a map of factor-factor protein contacts. Which transcription factors change their regulatory role most between flare and remission?

Leaves from 36 cassava plants, 18 infected with brown streak virus and 18 healthy, were RNA-sequenced; we hold nothing on transcription factor binding or protein contacts for this crop. Which transcription factors change their regulatory influence most after infection?

Facial skin biopsies from 10 rosacea patients were RNA-sequenced before and after twelve weeks of topical ivermectin, and these expression counts are everything we have. Which patients' gene networks changed the most from baseline to week twelve?

We made poly(A)-selected Illumina libraries from pituitary glands of 64 beef cattle collected at slaughter, with each animal's sex and age recorded. Which transcription factors vary most in activity from one animal to the next?

From 26 patients we took varicose and healthy saphenous vein segments, read full-length cDNA from each on a nanopore flow cell, and counted reads per gene. We want one regulatory network of saphenous vein from all 52 samples, nothing more.
We RNA-sequenced liver biopsies from nine children with glycogen storage disease type Ia. We want to see how each child's gene network differs from the others, with a confidence value for every edge.

We RNA-sequenced bone marrow from 23 aplastic anaemia patients before and after immunosuppressive therapy; we did not profile microRNAs, but we do have a JASPAR motif prior and a STRING protein network. Which patients' regulatory networks responded most to the therapy?

We have placental RNA-seq from 60 term pregnancies with birth weight recorded, plus a ChIP-seq-derived TF binding prior, a PPI network and TargetScan predictions for placental miRNAs. We want to know which transcription factors become more active as birth weight increases.

We have bulk RNA-seq of nasal epithelial brushings from 40 children with asthma and 40 healthy children, all collected during a single clinic visit. We want to find which transcription factors are more active in asthmatic airways than in healthy ones.
